subject: SparkBridge marketplace voucher nomination / accelerator cohort top-up
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@sparkbridge.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: alex.morgan@sparkbridge.com
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SparkBridge request: cohort top-up / marketplace voucher nomination

Hi Dylan —

Thanks again for the quick call this morning. As discussed, our next accelerator cohort (Dec 2026 intake) has a couple of early-stage teams who rely on marketplace credits to get initial infra running. We ran the usage estimates and expect ~150k tokens/day across 3 pilot teams for ~6 weeks.

Would Redwood be able to nominate a marketplace voucher (or co-fund a top-up) of $10K equivalent to cover the pilots? In return we’ll prominently highlight Redwood as our “recommended inference partner” in the cohort kickoff and include a short case blurb in the demo day materials.

Attached is a short proposal and the SOW draft with the footprint/usage assumptions. If it helps, Alex can join to walk through the numbers.

Proposed next steps:
- Quick approval or internal nomination by your partner credits team
- DocuSign for the voucher agreement / co-fund SOW
- Coordinate promo assets by Nov 20 for cohort kickoff on Dec 2

Appreciate any flexibility here — this accelerator feeds several product teams looking for a stable inference partner.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Partnerships | SparkBridge Accelerator
lena.ortiz@sparkbridge.com
attachments: SparkBridge_Accelerator_Proposal.pdf, SOW_Draft_SparkBridge_v1.docx

From: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: lena.ortiz@sparkbridge.com, alex.morgan@sparkbridge.com
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 11:29:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SparkBridge request: cohort top-up / marketplace voucher nomination

Marissa / Aditya —

Forwarding SparkBridge’s ask. Short version: SparkBridge wants a $10K marketplace voucher (or co-funded arrangement) for 3 pilot teams across our marketplace. In return they’ll feature Redwood in cohort materials and demo day. Attachments include their proposal + SOW draft.

Operational asks:
- Can we do an expedited voucher nomination from the partner credits pool?
- If we need a co-fund, what’s the minimal trackable doc (SOW or voucher terms) to get Finance/Legal to sign off quickly?

Timing: They want promo materials and kickoff coordination by Nov 20; cohort starts Dec 2.

Lena / Alex — I’ve CC’d Marissa (Partnerships lead for marketplace programs) and Aditya (Sales Ops / credits owner) so they can advise on process and timing.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
Dylan.Brooks@redwood.ai

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 08:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SparkBridge request: cohort top-up / marketplace voucher nomination

Thanks for the context, Dylan. I reviewed the proposal — straightforward ask and good PR upside. A few notes:

- Partner credits remaining in the marketplace pool: $32,400.
- Typical program approval for accelerators is up to $7.5K without exec sign-off; anything above requires Director approval (we can route).
- We need a one-page voucher agreement highlighting allowed usage and attribution. Legal prefers a short MSA addendum, but we can do a voucher form for speed.

Ask to Aditya: can you confirm whether a $10K nomination can be split (voucher $7.5K + Redwood co-fund $2.5K) and what the approval timeline is? If yes, Marissa will route for Director approval this morning.

Marissa Cole
Head, Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 10:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SparkBridge request: cohort top-up / marketplace voucher nomination

Marissa / Dylan —

We can split the request: voucher nomination $7,500 from the existing marketplace credits pool + $2,500 discretionary co-fund from the Partner Promotions budget. Finance/legal routing looks feasible within 48–72 hours if we keep the agreement to the voucher template + short SOW. I’ll prepare the voucher form and add a brief note for Director approval.

Requirements for the voucher form:
- Term: Dec 1–Jan 15
- Allowed usage: marketplace instances only, no export/data transfer guarantees (standard)
- Attribution: SparkBridge logs Redwood as "recommended inference partner" in cohort materials

I’ll upload the voucher draft + minimal SOW to the DocuSign room and share the link.

Aditya Rao
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai, lena.ortiz@sparkbridge.com
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: APPROVED: SparkBridge voucher nomination (7.5K) + Redwood co-fund (2.5K) — next steps

Lena / Alex —

Good news: Director has approved the split: Redwood will nominate a $7,500 marketplace voucher and co-fund $2,500 for the SparkBridge Dec cohort pilots. Congrats — we’re aligned on the attribution and timing.

Next steps (owners & timelines):
- Aditya to publish voucher and upload to DocuSign room for signatures (by EOD Nov 6) — aditya.rao@redwood.ai (DONE: voucher uploaded)
- Lena to confirm logo/attribution assets and where Redwood appears in kickoff slides (by Nov 16) — lena.ortiz@sparkbridge.com
- Dylan to coordinate a short blurb (75–100 words) and an intro slide for Demo Day (by Nov 20) — dylan.brooks@redwood.ai

I attached the signed voucher template (redacted) and a note from Finance confirming the $2,500 co-fund allocation. Make sure SparkBridge agrees to standard voucher terms.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the cohort kickoff.

Marissa Cole
Head, Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
attachments: Voucher_SparkBridge_7k5_cofund_2k5.pdf, Finance_Note_Cofund_2k5.pdf
